route: B: controlled multi-BS state sensing; detection and identity association are assumed successful

dataset.name: SinD public high-interaction subset
dataset.timestamp_rule: preserve audited source timestamp_ms; frame_id is an index, not a fixed-dt clock
dataset.velocity_frame: world/ground coordinate x-y components from SinD vx/vy
dataset.history_source: selected GT states keyed by (scene_id, frame_id, vehicle_id)
dataset.test_scope: never used for geometry search, preprocessing threshold selection, or SNR tuning

snr.seed_rule: base standard normals keyed by (scene_id, frame, bs_id, vehicle_id, channel); SNR excluded

measurement.calibration_source: Transferred unchanged from AUTOMATUM-CONTROLLED-ISAC-V2-FROZEN; no SinD test tuning

fusion.velocity_fusion: multi-BS radial-velocity least squares with weak prior

geometry_freeze.criteria: maximize >=2 BS coverage, then >=3 BS coverage, then median velocity condition ratio
